evaluation: BENCHMARK.md §6f — LLM recipe-generation vs the certified benchmark

choices.notes: Targets = events.tsv `value` in 11-55 with tens==units (11/22/33/44/55); all other 11-55 codes = standards; codes outside 11-55 (201/202 responses) ignored. Events built from the events.tsv `onset` column (seconds), attached as MNE Annotations on the raw before filtering so timing is preserved exactly across the resample to 256 Hz. EOG dropped by name (HEOG_left/HEOG_right/VEOG_lower), leaving exactly 30 scalp EEG channels; montage standard_1020 with match_case=False resolves the file's FP1/FP2 naming. Bandpass 0.1-30 Hz used MNE defaults (firwin, zero-phase, auto transition bands) at the native 1024 Hz, before resampling. Average reference applied directly (projection=False) over the 30 EEG channels. reject=None: every epoch averaged, no ICA/RANSAC/AutoReject. Difference wave via combine_evoked weights [1, -1] (target - standard). Measurement = grand mean of the difference-wave data over the 4 channels Fz/Cz/Pz/CPz and all samples with 0.300 <= t <= 0.500 s (inclusive mask, 52 samples at 256 Hz), scaled to microvolts.

Events taken from BIDS *_events.tsv `onset` (seconds) + `value`; TARGET iff tens digit == units digit (11/22/33/44/55), all other codes with both digits in 1..5 are STANDARD; 201/202 responses ignored. Events attached as MNE Annotations BEFORE filtering/resampling so onsets stay in sync, then converted with events_from_annotations after resampling (1024 -> 256 Hz is an exact factor of 4, so no event jitter). Steps run in the exact spec order: drop EOG by name -> standard_1020 (match_case=False, matches the file's FP1/FP2 naming) -> FIR bandpass 0.1-30 Hz with MNE defaults (firwin/hamming, phase='zero') -> resample 256 Hz -> average reference over the 30 scalp channels (projection=False, applied directly). No ICA, no RANSAC/interpolation, no AutoReject, reject=None/flat=None so every epoch is averaged. Measurement: difference wave via mne.combine_evoked([target, standard], weights=[1,-1]), then mean over the 4 channels Fz/Cz/Pz/CPz and over the inclusive time mask 0.300 <= t <= 0.500 s, scaled 1e6 V->uV. Per-subject values rounded to 3 decimals; grand mean computed from unrounded values.
